lines.text: A Deck App for **Host Control**. It lists the computers linked in the VitaDeck Shell with each one's live CPU load, and for the selected one shows its capabilities, CPU and memory gauges from the built-in `systemStats` plugin, and an Echo round trip.
From this repo, `pnpm --dir js host-companion` runs the [Host Companion](../../packages/host-companion/README.md) that `vitadeck-host-companion` installs:
1. On the computer: `pnpm --dir js host-companion start`.
2. On VitaDeck: press Start, open Host Control, and note the link address.
3. On the computer: `pnpm --dir js host-companion link <link address>`.
Link more computers the same way; each gets its own row. D-pad and Cross pick one.
import { Button, Rect, Screen, Stack, Text, insetContent, useTheme, type Color } from "@vitadeck/sdk";
// A timed-out fetch keeps running natively for up to 30 s, so an unanswering computer is polled no faster than that.
// Links change from the Shell while the Deck App runs, so they are read again every second.
// One request at a time, so a slow computer never piles up requests. Returns a stop function.
function pollSystemStats(hostId: string, onResult: (result: HostResult<SystemStats>) => void): () => void {
timer = setTimeout(() => void poll(), !result.ok && result.code === "timeout" ? OFFLINE_POLL_MS : POLL_MS);
function Gauge({ label, percent, detail }: { label: string; percent: number; detail: string }) {
const fill: Color = percent >= 85 ? theme.danger : percent >= 60 ? theme.warning : theme.success;
if (result.code === "forbidden") return "This Vita's address changed. Link it again from Host Control in the Shell.";
return "Is the Host Companion running? vitadeck-host-companion start";
function HostDetails({ host, stats }: { host: LinkedHost; stats: HostResult<SystemStats> | undefined }) {
const [echo, setEcho] = useState("Press Echo to time a round trip.");
const result = await createHostClient(corePlugin, { hostId: host.id }).capabilities();
const reply = await createHostClient(corePlugin, { hostId: host.id }).echo({ text: "Hello from the Vita" });
const selected = hosts.find((host) => host.id === selectedId) ?? hosts[0];
const { x, y, width, height } = insetContent();
<Stack x={x} y={y} width={width} height={height} direction="row" gap={20}>

"No computer is linked.

1. On the computer: vitadeck-host-companion start
2. Press Start, open Host Control in the Shell.
3. On the computer, run the link command it shows."
Link a computer to see its stats here.
